name: What should I consider regarding ventilation when installing a new double vanity?
description: Evaluate your bathroom's ventilation when installing a double vanity; increased use may require upgrading your exhaust fan to prevent humidity issues.

mainEntity.name: What should I consider regarding ventilation when installing a new double vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: When installing a new double vanity, particularly if it's part of a larger bathroom remodel, consider the impact on your bathroom's ventilation. Increased use of the bathroom with two sinks can lead to higher humidity. Adequate ventilation prevents mold and mildew growth and protects your new vanity and finishes. This might involve assessing your existing exhaust fan's capacity and potentially upgrading it to one with a higher CFM (Cubic Feet per Minute) rating. Proper airflow is a key factor in maintaining the longevity and air quality of your renovated bathroom.
